newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average fell 35.79 points to 6,660.69 on Monday, putting the blue-chip index about 223 points below the record of 6,883.90 set on Jan 21 as concerns about upward pressure on wages lifted long-term interest rates to the highest level in four months.
* About 250 shops and a Matahari department store were destroyed or damaged when fire swept through a shopping complex in central Jakarta on Monday, police and eyewitnesses said.

* The Jakarta Composite index closed 6.07 points, or 0.89 percent, higher at 684.98 points on Monday, with reports in favour of Jakarta over some other Asian markets boosting sentiment on big-caps, brokers said.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,371.75/72.25 in early trading against the opening of 2,372.00/72.50.
* Jakarta International Hotels and Development on reports its unit had secured a $232.7 million loan to finance a property project in Jakarta.
* Prasidha on the company's plan to open its first powdered and instant coffee plant in March.
* Sierad Produce on announcement it had open a 400-seat restaurant in China.
* Hotel Prapatan on reports it expected strong 1996 results following the launch of new restaurants in 1996.
* Mulialand on reports its majority stakeholder has proposed to issue exchangable bonds to finance Mulialand's property project in West Jakarta.
* Bimantara on news it was expected to sell its stake in tyre firm PT Intirub.
* Tapioca starch maker Budi Acid on reports it was in negotiations to set up two joint ventures with local and Japanese firms.
